description: This file contains a benchmarking script for measuring performance metrics (registration time, memory footprint, cold start time, invocation latency) of LangChain tools, including functions for creating tools, measuring their performance, and outputting results in JSON or text format.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: Data class for statistical metrics such as mean, stddev, min, max, and percentiles.

methods.name: calculate_stats
methods.description: Calculates statistical metrics from a list of float data.

methods.name: benchmark_tool_registration
methods.description: Measures time to create LangChain tools over multiple iterations.

methods.name: benchmark_memory
methods.description: Measures memory footprint of LangChain tools over multiple iterations.

methods.name: benchmark_cold_start
methods.description: Measures time to create a minimal LangChain setup.

methods.name: benchmark_tool_invocation
methods.description: Measures latency of invoking LangChain tools.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs all benchmarks and outputs results.
